deviations_from_card: Four commits instead of three: the test commit carries a stub LinkState (red by design: 8 of 9 tests failed on assertions, case 1 is the guard; :core:test is red on 6c4ee20c only), then LinkState, then LinkState's peekLeftMs and PIN_REFUSALS with 2 extra tests, then ONE tv-app commit (Session flow, PenSessionHost events, PairingCard.kt, MainActivity swap, Menu key, status-line gating) because commits 2 and 3 of the card's rollback plan share MainActivity.kt hunks. The 11 tests are the card's 8 cases (case 1 GUARD) plus 3 extras (Ready replaces the address; peek time left; the refusals the card shows equal the reasons PenConversation gives). tv-app-A's wrong-PIN Unpaired and shared conversation were already on the tree and are consumed as the card expected (Paired -> PenPaired, Unpaired -> PenGone, Welcome(accepted=false) -> PenRefused). Premise re-verified on the tree: all eight held (MainActivity line numbers moved, content identical); tools/live-ui-test.mjs does not read the status line or the card (it only excludes the card region from ink pixels), so gating the status line is safe for the harness.
notes: User-visible changes beyond the card's list: (1) the invite card is larger than the old 180dp one (260dp wide, 200dp QR, 52sp PIN, 16sp URL, 14sp via line) because it is only up when a pen is needed; (2) the displayed URL no longer shows the ?pin= query (the PIN is its own large value; the QR still encodes the full URL); (3) the card is no longer drawn with a top-end 24dp outer padding inside MainActivity, the padding moved into PairingCard; (4) a 'connecting' state shows 'Connecting...' in 22sp; (5) the transport failure is now the whole card (22sp bold red) instead of a 10sp line under the QR, and the 'via lan' text is gone from the failure view; (6) the status line is hidden by default and shows only during a Menu peek (this was in the card's flow but changes the always-on 16sp bottom-left text); (7) Menu is now consumed by the activity (returns true) so it no longer falls through to the system. (8) Refusals are reported only for the two PIN reasons ('wrong PIN', 'too many wrong PINs'); a silent connection that times out ('no pairing message') shows nothing, by design, since it is not a phone that tried; 'too many wrong PINs' shows 'Too many tries'. (9) On a shared (relay) conversation a wrong PIN unpairs the current pen (tv-app-A's rule), so the card returns as 'Pen lost' after the 3 s grace even though the refusal itself is invisible during a pen: that is truthful but is a consequence of A. Disagreement with the scout: none on the design; I key a stale close by client id plus, in PenSessionHost, by pen.isCurrent, because a phone that reconnects under the SAME clientId would otherwise have its old connection's close read as the current pen leaving (the card's by-id rule alone misses that). The address poll is 1 Hz in a lifecycleScope loop in MainActivity (was a 30 Hz accidental poll in the composable); failure is polled in the same loop (failure != null -> Failed, else Ready clears it), so a transport that recovers clears the Failed view. The card keeps a 250 ms clock inside PairingCard only, so the screen's own ~30 Hz recomposition no longer re-enumerates NetworkInterface. NOT RUN: no emulator or device run and no TV capture (the card names an operator-run before/after emulator capture and the Menu key itself); compile gate plus JVM tests only. The Compose rendering (sizes, the 16dp dot, layout of Refused/Failed cards) is unverified on a screen.
